title: Wholesome Warm Vietnamese Mixed Grain Bun Cha
description: Rich, velvety Vietnamese dish made with mixed grain, featuring a smoke-cold flavor profile without onions or garlic. Perfect for a comforting hangover cure.

ingredients.name: Fresh Cilantro
ingredients.notes: Optional, omit if fresh herbs not desired.

ingredients.name: Fragrant Star Anise
ingredients.notes: Optional, omit if flavor not desired.

ingredients.name: Fragrant Cinnamon stick
ingredients.notes: Optional, omit if flavor not desired.

instructions: Combine mixed grain rice, water, palm sugar, fish sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, salt, and black pepper in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 18 minutes or until liquid has been absorbed.
In a separate pan, smoke the ground pork over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until it reaches a tender, caramelized texture.
Add the fragrant star anise and cinnamon stick to the pan and continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Remove the star anise and cinnamon stick from the pan and stir in the cooked mixed grain rice, breaking up any clumps.
Transfer the mixture to a lacquerware bowl and garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
